create_cohere_config: create a CohereConfig instance to initialize a Cohere model configuration with default parameters
build_cohere_config_custom: build a CohereConfig with custom vocab_size, hidden_size, and num_hidden_layers for a variant model
review_cohere_config_post_init: review the CohereConfig __post_init__ method that defaults num_key_value_heads to num_attention_heads
summarize_cohere_config_attributes: summarize the CohereConfig class attributes including vocab_size, hidden_size, and rope_parameters
test_cohere_config_init: test the CohereConfig initialization with custom attention_bias, use_cache, and logit_scale values
